name: Shoe Grid
description: Full-screen 3D product grid of shoe images on a topographic shader background. Drag to pan, zoom between overview and close-up, switch collections through a floating control island, and buy the focused item.
contents: Grid of product tiles with image, title, price and color
Header with brand name and tagline
Floating control island with collection tabs, zoom and buy buttons
Mini map of the grid and a loading screen
behavior: WebGL scene with drag-to-pan camera rig and animated zoom between overview and focus
Tiles with holographic card shader and animated topography background
Collection switch animates the old grid out and the new grid in
Collections are built from item brands unless a collections prop is given
editableByProps: Products, images, prices, collections and all labels
Colors, grid columns, tile size, gap and zoom levels

needsCodeEdit.change: Tune camera, damping and transition timing

fixed: Root is fixed and covers the whole viewport, so it should be the only content on the page
Blocks touch scrolling on the page area (touch-none) because dragging pans the grid
Runs a WebGL canvas and a requestAnimationFrame sync loop, cleaned up on unmount
Default product images load from a remote GitHub URL
